metadata.host_selection_rule: storage-only: direct child contract with most references; lexical canonical-id tie-break

semantics.local_rule: Local DWH read/write availability follows exact local schema/instance and applicable governance.
semantics.remote_rule: Remote exposure/delegation is independently declared and may be narrower than local access.
semantics.ac_rule: AccessCore authorization remains orthogonal and must be evaluated where active/applicable.
semantics.nonexpansion_rule: Broader local owner rights never automatically expand delegated remote rights.
semantics.delegation_rule: Remote delegation is exact, bounded and target-specific.
semantics.off_rule: DWH local/remote scope semantics remain meaningful independently from whether AC is globally active; when AC is active it composes as an additional authorization gate.
semantics.identity_rule: Local identity, remote peer identity and source resource identity remain distinct.
semantics.failure_rule: Missing remote policy denies remote exposure even if local access succeeds.

invariants.rule: Remote DWH sharing exposes only explicitly scoped and schema-governed data; transport reachability, endpoint registration, local authorization or broader local ownership never silently expands delegated remote rights.

hard_gates.condition: local admin rights copied automatically to remote peer
remote rights expanded from local ownership
AC state used to erase DWH scope semantics
missing remote policy defaults to local policy
peer identity conflated with source identity

references.purpose: Delegated remote rights cannot silently expand.
Remote exposure uses explicit scope identity.
